# Spec: npm WASM Package

## Purpose
Publish the CodeViz WASM module to npm so browser tool builders can
`npm install codeviz` without any manual WASM build steps.

---

## Package Name
`codeviz` (or `@codeviz/wasm` if the bare name is taken)

## package.json
```json
{
  "name": "codeviz",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Zero-drift architecture diagrams from source code — WASM build",
  "main": "codeviz_wasm.js",
  "types": "codeviz_wasm.d.ts",
  "files": ["codeviz_wasm.js", "codeviz_wasm_bg.wasm", "codeviz_wasm.d.ts"],
  "sideEffects": false
}
```

## TypeScript Types (generated by wasm-bindgen)
Ensure the generated `.d.ts` file includes:
```typescript
export function parse(source: string, language: string, diagram_kind: string): string;
export function parse_to_json(source: string, language: string): string;
export function supported_languages(): string[];
export default function init(input?: string | URL | Request): Promise<void>;
```

## Publish Workflow
`.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml`:
- Trigger: push of tag `v*`
- Steps: `wasm-pack build --target bundler` → `npm publish`
- Requires `NPM_TOKEN` secret in repository settings

---

## Acceptance Criteria
- `npm install codeviz && node -e "const {parse} = require('codeviz'); ..."` works.
- TypeScript types are accurate and complete.
- Package size is < 3MB (enforced in publish workflow).
- CDN import works: `import init, {parse} from 'https://unpkg.com/codeviz/codeviz_wasm.js'`
